title: SatTrack objects dataset
description: Every tracked object with its OMM element set and the fields the app filters on (docs/app-data-contract.md, decisions D-009 to D-011). Written by pipeline/scripts/export_app_csvs.py, which validates every record against this schema before publishing. Field names are the dbt mart column names; their definitions are in the dbt docs. Additive changes keep the schema number; renaming a field or changing its meaning raises it. Schema 2 (D-047): constellation replaced by satellite_constellation_name, primary_satellite_system_name and satellite_system_names.

count.description: Number of records; equals the length of records.

generated_at.description: When the export wrote the file (UTC).

run_id.description: Pipeline run that built the tracking mart.

labels.description: Always a list; empty when there are none.

object_id.description: International designator (OBJECT_ID), e.g. 1998-067A; 'UNKNOWN' for analyst objects.

object_type.description: Space-Track OBJECT_TYPE: PAYLOAD, ROCKET BODY, DEBRIS or UNKNOWN today; a new value is allowed.

epoch.description: Element set epoch, UTC, %Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%S.%f (the format sgp4 / satellite.js read).

satellite_constellation_name.description: The constellation the object belongs to (near-identical satellites working together), e.g. Starlink or Sentinel-2; null when none (D-047). Credit: Constellation groups: CelesTrak (Dr T.S. Kelso).

primary_satellite_system_name.description: The satellite system the object was built for, e.g. GPS; null when none (D-047).

satellite_system_names.description: Every satellite system the object belongs to, primary first, then systems it hosts a payload for (e.g. Search & Rescue (SARSAT), EGNOS); empty when none (D-047).

flag_space_station.description: 1 when the object is in CelesTrak's Space Stations group (the ISS and Tiangong modules and visiting spacecraft), else 0 (D-043). Credit: Constellation groups: CelesTrak (Dr T.S. Kelso).
